simplefun.guide.page.1.title: Simple Fun
simplefun.guide.page.1: Bounded playful mechanics, throwable bricks and cosmetic transformations. The animal heads moved to Simple Mobheads.
simplefun.guide.page.2.title: Sneak Throw
simplefun.guide.page.2: Sneak while dropping items. Server multiplier 0.1–3, velocity capped at 1.5 blocks/tick, pickup delay 20 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.3.title: Throwable Bricks
simplefun.guide.page.3: Brick, nether brick and resin brick: throw with use. Server cooldown 10 ticks, lifetime 200 ticks, damage 0–4. Glass breaking defaults off.
simplefun.guide.page.4.title: Piggy Transformation
simplefun.guide.page.4: Eating raw or cooked pork grants a cosmetic pig head for five minutes; milk removes the effect.
simplefun.guide.page.5.title: Damageless
simplefun.guide.page.5: Feather melee and Damageless I deal zero direct melee damage, with knockback. Novice librarians offer the book for 25 emeralds, three uses. Switches control effect and trades.
simplefun.guide.page.6.title: Knockback V
simplefun.guide.page.6: Vanilla Knockback accepts feathers/sticks and levels up to five; this replaces vanilla enchantment data and can collide with datapacks.
simplefun.guide.page.7.title: Admin Commands
simplefun.guide.page.7: Permission level 4: /simplefun tweaks yeet toggle/strength; /simplefun tweaks bricks enable/breakGlass/damage/snowballDamage. Values are bounded server-side.
simplefun.guide.page.8.title: Brick Snowball
simplefun.guide.page.8: Four snowballs around one brick craft one. Stack 16. Separate switch; damage 0–4, throw cooldown 10 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.9.title: Flower Sniff
simplefun.guide.page.9: Cosmetic delight: hold a flower and sneak. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.10.title: Cookie Crumbs
simplefun.guide.page.10: Cosmetic delight: eat a cookie. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.11.title: Apple Sparkle
simplefun.guide.page.11: Cosmetic delight: eat an apple. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.12.title: Carrot Crunch
simplefun.guide.page.12: Cosmetic delight: eat a carrot. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.13.title: Melon Splash
simplefun.guide.page.13: Cosmetic delight: eat melon. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.14.title: Honey Bubbles
simplefun.guide.page.14: Cosmetic delight: drink honey. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.15.title: Bread Crumbs
simplefun.guide.page.15: Cosmetic delight: eat bread. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.16.title: Berry Blush
simplefun.guide.page.16: Cosmetic delight: eat sweet or glow berries. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.17.title: Server Configuration
simplefun.guide.page.17: Two tabs cover gameplay and small delights; every option explains its default. Gameplay uses only server settings.
simplefun.guide.page.18.title: Creative tabs
simplefun.guide.page.18: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
simplefun.guide.page.19.title: Settings
simplefun.guide.page.19: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
